message:
`<div>` with a mouseenter or mouseleave handler must have an ARIA role
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions

Using `on:mouseenter` to listen to the mouseenter event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmouseenter` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `on:mouseleave` to listen to the mouseleave event is deprecated. Use the event attribute `onmouseleave` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/event_directive_deprecated

Using `<slot>` to render parent content is deprecated. Use `{@render ...}` tags instead
https://svelte.dev/e/slot_element_deprecated

`hovering` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
